33 · 00:25:19 · 蜂窝频谱的稀缺性与使用成本

原标说话人 1 00:25:19
So, what we were saying is, essentially, that we are referring to mobile communication networks using cellular technology. So, we said, let's consider that this is the area, the geographical area. This rectangle is the geographical area where we need to serve our users, provide cellular connectivity to our users. And what we said is, radio resources, that means portions of the frequency spectrum that we use to send signals, are precious, because we don't have many frequencies, ever. In particular, for cellular communications, the mobile operators, like those who provide us with 5G connectivity, need to pay the ministry of communications of each country in order to be able to use certain frequencies and provide connectivity to their customers. Okay? And these frequencies are very, very pricey. Okay, so mobile operators need to pay a lot of money.
我们刚才说的，基本上是指使用蜂窝技术的移动通信网络。我们说过，假设这里是一个区域，一个地理区域。这个矩形就是我们需要为用户提供服务、提供蜂窝连接的地理区域。我们说过，无线电资源，也就是用于发送信号的频谱片段，是很宝贵的，因为可用的频率从来都不多。特别是在蜂窝通信中，移动运营商，比如为我们提供5G连接的那些运营商，需要向各国的通信主管部门付费，才能使用某些频率，为客户提供连接。好吗？这些频率非常、非常昂贵。所以，移动运营商需要支付大量资金。
